title: Observability & interop
description: Standards-based ingestion health and ledger-correlated trace drill-down. Figures are engine-wide (process-global), not per-tenant; standards are pinned to the versions and maturities the upstream bodies declare.

engineScope.note: These figures are engine-wide (process-global), not per-tenant. The read-model counters accumulate since engine start and reset on restart — the same lifecycle as the engine's Prometheus /metrics, never per-tenant.

ingestion.title: Per-standard ingestion health
ingestion.description: Each interop standard the engine ingests or emits, with its pinned version, declared maturity and pipe status.
ingestion.liveNote: Live read-model: the engine counts records per bus source since engine start. A per-standard row carries a counter only where the attribution is sound — a figure is never invented, and an absent value means "not soundly attributable", not zero.
ingestion.optInOff: Convention in Development — off by default; enable via the connector gate.
ingestion.blockedNote: Push transport is blocked on the off-box collector seam; the pull export remains the offline re-verification path.

sources.title: Live counters by bus source
sources.description: One row per bus source (connector/module) with its records by observation kind and, for edges, by collector signal.
sources.empty: No records observed on the bus since engine start
sources.emptyHint: Counters start at zero on every engine start; nothing has flowed yet — this is an observation, not a failure.
sources.sinceNote: Counters are process-global and accumulate since engine start ({{since}}); they reset on restart, like /metrics.

traces.title: W3C Trace Context drill-down
traces.description: Traces correlated by the W3C trace ids stamped on audit-ledger events, grouped by engine span.
traces.listDescription: Select a trace to open its ledger-derived span view.
traces.emptyHint: No audit-ledger event in the walk window (last 20,000 events) carries a W3C trace id — callers are not propagating traceparent, or the window has rolled past them.
traces.filterNoResults: No traces match the active filters.
traces.selectPrompt: Select a trace to see its span waterfall.
traces.exportTitle: Download OTLP-compatible JSON for Jaeger / Tempo / Datadog
traces.liveNote: Ledger-correlation read-model: rows are derived from the W3C trace ids stamped on audit-ledger events (walk window: the last 20,000 events). Bars are LEDGER-EVENT windows grouped by engine span id — the engine stores no OTel spans; the full spans live in the operator's OTLP collector.
traces.chartSummary: Span waterfall: {{count}} spans over {{duration}}, indented by parent-child depth and sized by duration.
traces.level1Note: W3C Trace Context is validated only at its Stable Level 1 (v00 traceparent / tracestate). No Level-2 semantics are claimed.

ingestionHealth.title: No ingestion standards declared
ingestionHealth.description: The engine's compiled standards inventory must supply these rows; operators do not add them through the console.

ingestionSources.title: No bus sources observed since engine start
ingestionSources.description: A connector or module must publish an edge, cost sample or finding on the event bus before its live source counters appear here.

trace.title: No W3C traces observed yet
trace.description: Callers must propagate W3C trace context so audit-ledger events among the latest 20,000 entries carry trace IDs.

traceWaterfallChart.title: No span timings recorded for this trace
traceWaterfallChart.description: Ledger events must carry engine span IDs before this view can show each span's start offset, duration, actor and status.
